newsitem.title: CHINA: HK man nicked for nicking policewomen's underwear.
newsitem.headline: HK man nicked for nicking policewomen's underwear.

text.p: A Hong Kong man nicked for stealing policewomen's knickers was sentenced on Monday to 30 months in jail, a Hong Kong newspaper reported on Monday.
Kung Man-wah, a 33-year-old janitor, was nabbed in February in the women's changing room at the Kwai Chung police station, a court heard.
At the time of his arrest he was wearing ladies' underwear that he had stolen on a similar raid at the same police station less than 24 hours earlier, the New Evening Post said.
The defendant pleaded guilty. He stole some bras, panties and a slip, the newspaper said. Kung had previous convictions for similar activities.
His defence lawyer pleaded for leniency, saying Kung "had a penchant for sniffing ladies' underpants".
